title: Formatting: BBCode
description:
[b]Bold text[/b] and [B]bold in capitals[/B].
[i]Italic text[/i] and [u]underlined text[/u].
[color=#123456]Colored text[/color] without the color.

A [url=https://example.com/download]named link[/url] and a plain one: [url]https://example.com/plain[/url]

[img]https://example.com/image.png[/img]

title: Formatting: references and mentions
description:
#1 at the start of the text, and see #2 in the middle.

Not references: https://example.com/page#3, word#4,  and # without a number.

Mentions: @user and @another-user. Not mentions: name@example.com and https://name@example.com/path

Angle brackets stay visible: <placeholder> and <@user> said something.

comments.author: Alice
comments.text: Thanks @user, this looks like a duplicate of #1.

title: Formatting: quotes
description:
Text before a quote.
[quote=Alice]A quote with an author.
It spans two lines.[/quote]
Text after the quote, which must not end up inside it.

comments.author: Bob
comments.text:
[quote]A quote without an author.[/quote]
Reply below it.

comments.author: Carol
comments.text:
[quote=Bob]Outer quote [quote=Alice]inner quote[/quote] back in the outer quote.[/quote]
Reply to both.

title: Formatting: code blocks and plain text
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Run the command.
2. Look at the changed files:
[code]
 file.txt | 3 [color=#00FF00]++[/color][color=#FF0000]-[/color]
[/code]
additional_information: Plain text that only looks like markup: [note] this stays, 0000001:0000002 and ~1.
